remedies.name: Ceramide moisturizer
traditionalUses: Supports the skin barrier and helps reduce moisture loss.
remedies.method: Apply to clean, slightly damp skin 1-2 times daily.
remedies.safety: Patch test first if you have reactive skin.
remedies.notes: This is educational and not a medical treatment for a diagnosed condition.

remedies.name: Niacinamide serum
traditionalUses: Helps support oil balance and the skin barrier.
remedies.method: Use a few drops once daily after cleansing.
remedies.notes: Not a cure for acne or other diagnosed conditions.

remedies.name: Squalane lipid support
traditionalUses: Helps support skin softness and barrier comfort.
remedies.method: Apply sparingly to damp skin or as a finishing step after moisturizer.
remedies.safety: Avoid if irritation develops; stop use and seek advice if symptoms persist or worsen.
remedies.notes: Traditional use and gentle conditioning; not a replacement for medical care.

remedies.name: Salicylic acid cleanser
traditionalUses: Helps exfoliate inside pores and support oil management.
remedies.method: Use 1-3 times weekly depending on tolerance.
remedies.safety: Do not use on open wounds or severely irritated skin.
remedies.notes: This is not a prescription treatment and may irritate sensitive skin.

remedies.name: Hyaluronic acid hydration
traditionalUses: Helps improve skin hydration and smoothness.
avoidIf: Very oily skin if it feels heavy
remedies.method: Apply to damp skin before moisturizer.
remedies.safety: Use a moisturizer afterward if your skin feels tight.
remedies.notes: Helpful for hydration, but not a treatment for diagnosed skin disease.

remedies.name: Daily broad-spectrum sunscreen
traditionalUses: Helps reduce UV-related irritation and supports long-term skin comfort.
remedies.method: Apply to exposed skin every morning and reapply as needed during sun exposure.
remedies.safety: Choose fragrance-free formulas if you are sensitive.
remedies.notes: Daily protection is a key part of skin wellness and preventing irritation.

remedies.name: Lemon juice
traditionalUses: Traditional home remedy for appearance concerns.
remedies.safety: This is not recommended for facial use because it can irritate and worsen dryness, sensitivity, and pigmentation concerns.
remedies.notes: Avoid DIY use of lemon juice on the face due to irritation risk and photosensitivity.
